title: WORTH A TRY FOR THE PRICE
text:
The first box I got was January 2019. It included 2 full-size Sunday Riley products worth approx. $80 each and I was really psyched. Since then I seem to be getting some disappointing substitutes instead of the spoilers advertised. Idk if this is because I signed up late in the month (I got my May box in June for instance). Perhaps if I signed up earlier in the month that wouldn't be the case.

That said, there are still items I like and I do feel I am getting more than my money's worth. One item alone is easily worth the $15. For rxample, I am currently wearing a really nice pink Lakur nail polish which cost about $16 on Amazon.

The plastic cosmetic containers/bags the products come in are useless. They usually come torn.

With the ease of cancelling with Amazon, it's definitely worth the initial $10 to see what you think.

Enough websites have spoilers to give you an idea if you want to continue.
label: neutral
